newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania estimated 1997 year/year inflation 110 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania estimated 1997 year/year inflation 110 pct.

text.p: Year-on-year inflation in Romania is estimated at around 110 percent this year, Romanian Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea said on Tuesday.
"We expect six percent inflation in May and then monthly rates of two to three percent from June to the end of the year," Ciorbea said.
Previous official forecasts put 12-month inflation in 1997 at 89.5 percent against 56.9 percent in 1996.
